scheme_name: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Middle Income Group
other_conditions: Beneficiary family must not own a pucca (all‑weather) house anywhere in India
The family must not have availed any central housing assistance from the Government of India
Annual household income must be between ₹6,00,001 and ₹12,00,000 (MIG‑I) or between ₹12,00,001 and ₹18,00,000 (MIG‑II)
For a married couple, either spouse or both together can be eligible for a single house, subject to the income eligibility
A beneficiary family includes husband, wife, unmarried sons and/or unmarried daughters; an adult earning member can be treated as a separate household

Preference may be given to women (especially widows and single working women), SC/ST/OBC beneficiaries, persons with disabilities, and transgender applicants, but this is not a mandatory eligibility criterion
benefits_summary: Interest subsidy on housing loans up to 4% for MIG‑I and 3% for MIG‑II, with eligible loan amounts of up to ₹9 lakh and ₹12 lakh respectively for a tenure of up to 20 years
